records.rule: Prose is labeled blocks, not one unbroken narrative.
records.source_quote: I want the reader to be able to find specific information easily by scanning the labels.

records.rule: Complete, connected sentences inside each block; no clipped fragments.
records.source_quote: I do like prose within the blocks vs just incomplete sentences

records.rule: One theme per block; health / communication / social-emotional / life history never share a block.
Every emitted block is supported by ledger facts; no forced or empty blocks, no "No information was available."
records.source_quote: Use whichever the sources support, and don't force empty ones

records.rule: Intervention routed by where it happened — school-provided to Educational History, private to the parent's account.
records.source_quote: Intervention history routes by WHERE the intervention happened

records.rule: Write about the child, never the paperwork.
Informants stay distinct; the reader can always tell who said what.
records.source_quote: I like it all kept separate… It may be too homogenized.

gate: This narrative provides a snapshot of her journey…
records.rule: No meta-narration; do not close on sentences about the narrative itself.
records.source_quote: This narrative provides a snapshot of her journey…
